messages:
isabel.partnerships: Quick kickoff 1

isabel.partnerships: OK team 1: packaging strategy for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Two main offerings: SaaS-API (hosted Redwood) + optional Edge Accelerator add-on (partner hardware). We need: publisher IDs, SKU mapping (bundle vs standalone), trial entitlements, marketing assets, and marketplace-specific manifest. Also schedule partner preview for next Tue.

ben.legal: For public listing we need standard marketplace legal pages per vendor. I will adapt our global T&C -> AWS marketplace terms, GCP SaaS terms, and Azure managed-app terms. Localize EN/DE/FR/ES. Note: for Azure private plans we must include a support SLA summary in the listing.

sophia.prod: SKU proposal: 
- `redwood-api-standard` (14d trial, no-cc)
- `redwood-api-enterprise` (private plan, invoice billing)
- `redwood-edge-accelerator` (add-on, one-time provisioning)
Entitlement mapping: trial -> `trial_entitlement_v1`, private plan -> `partner_invoice_entitlement_v1`.
Listing metadata that partners care about: `eu_data_only`, `supports_vpc_peering`, `edge_addon_compatible`.

sophia.prod: Here's a sample manifest snippet for the partner catalog (JSON):

```json
{  "offerId": "redwood-inference-offer",  "publisherId": "replace-with-publisher",  "skus": [    {"id": "redwood-api-standard", "pricingModel": "metered", "trialDays": 14},    {"id": "redwood-api-enterprise", "pricingModel": "subscription", "billing": "monthly"},    {"id": "redwood-edge-accelerator", "pricingModel": "one_time"}  ],  "metadata": {"eu_data_only": false, "regions": ["us-east1","europe-west1"], "supportContact": "support@redwood.com"}}
```

sophia.prod: Note: the `publisherId` will be the vendor-specific ID (AWS/GCP/Azure). We should not hardcode it in our repo.

matt.ops: Ops checklist:
- AWS: create private-offer, upload assets to AWS Sandbox, test entitlement provisioning webhook. Use role `redwood-marketplace-uploader@redwood-infra`.
- GCP: upload SaaS listing via Partner Portal, validate OAuth redirect URIs, and test auto-provisioning webhook.
- Azure: register as publisher, submit Managed Application draft, and set up Private Plan mapping.

matt.ops: I'll run the AWS sandbox flow tonight and paste logs. If we hit manifest schema mismatch, will open a ticket. Contact: infra@redwood.com for publisher contact.

ben.legal: One policy note: AWS requires clear refunds/termination language for trials that start charging after trial ends. Also ensure we surface the data-processing addendum link in EU listings.

isabel.partnerships: Marketing asks: hero banner (landscape, 1200x400), 15s demo GIF, and short copy (<=90 chars). Prefer callout: "Deploy LLMs with predictable inference economics". Can marketing own these assets?

sophia.prod: I've added listing copy + quickstart curl examples to the draft PR: https://git.redwood/marketplace/listing-draft. Example token price in doc: `0.00035 USD per token unit (10k = 3.5 USD)` but final number TBD.

jira-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-PL-6423: "Marketplace listing - packaging + private offers" assigned to isabel.partnerships, due 2024-06-24.

isabel.partnerships: Action items: 1) @ben.legal finalize localized terms + DPA link (due Fri 12:00 UTC). 2) @sophia.prod confirm final SKU ids + pricing matrix (due Thu EOD). 3) @matt.ops complete AWS sandbox deploy + provide provisioning webhook test (due Wed 23:59 UTC). 4) Marketing produce hero + GIF (due Mon). Follow-up sync Thu 09:30 PT in #partnerships. :rocket:

matt.ops: Aiming for the Thursday sync, will post sandbox results here earlier.

ben.legal: I'll ping once localized T&Cs are uploaded.

isabel.partnerships: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the partner preview packet once items are done and circulate to partners.
